name: @hia-doc/hia-sassdoc-workspace
description: Workspace for HIA Sass documentation packages.

scripts.check:syntax: node --check scripts/check-skeleton.cjs && node --check scripts/check-license-audit.cjs && node --check scripts/release-check.cjs && node --check scripts/build-fixtures.cjs && node --check scripts/check-fixtures.cjs
scripts.release:gate: npm run check:syntax && npm run build:fixtures && npm run check:skeleton && npm run check:fixtures && npm run license:audit && npm run release:check && npm pack --dry-run --json
scripts.test: npm run build:fixtures && npm run check:skeleton && npm run check:fixtures
